title: Complete connected-component classification of generic genus-zero isoresidual fibers with an arbitrary number of zeros

context_spans.label: Complete fixed author work:setup,definitions,all proofs,drawings,conjectures,open problems andbibliography declaration retained unchanged.

standard_prerequisites: Cited author multi-scale compactification and log-period results; exact original hypotheses and citations retained.
Known minimal-stratum counts and translation/dilation-surface rotation/spin invariants where invoked.
core_obligations: Given the completed translation-structure theorem and cited rotation/spin invariants, the remaining author classification must prove both attainability and completeness of the two exceptional families. The author identifies saddle adjacency with explicit moves of decorated rooted graphs, constructs canonical forms with and without simple poles, proves the permutation/parity and gcd orbit classifications, and then uses the zero-merging incidence and monodromy action to pass from two zeros to an arbitrary number. The surgical rotation/Arf invariants alone only give lower bounds; the nonroutine graph moves and incidence argument establish that there are no additional components. Count the full genus-zero generic-fiber Theorem1.7 as one H3 classification,not separate counts for every helper or exceptional case.
